headline: Executive order directs federal efforts to protect the country from the harms caused by invasive species.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with invasive species, which are plants, animals, and other living things that are not native to an area and can cause harm. Based on its title, it directs the federal government to work on preventing and reducing the damage these species cause. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, programs, and agency duties are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are likely directed to take steps to prevent, control, or respond to invasive species, though the exact duties are not stated in the source material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 5, 2016; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
